# Work with Historical Data

> **Status:** Stub — content to be expanded.

## Overview

How to query previous PSGC masterlist releases (2023–2026) using `use_version()`, the `as_of` parameter, and `resolve_date()`.

## Switch the global version

```python
import barangay

barangay.use_version("2025-07-08")
brgy = barangay.barangays.lookup("1907005010")
barangay.use_version(None)  # back to latest
```
